website.note: No /pipeline page; XOMA Royalty is a royalty aggregator, not a clinical-stage developer

ctgov.note: All 26 historical XOMA-sponsored or XOMA-collaborator trials are TERMINATED, COMPLETED, or SUSPENDED; no active P1/P2/P3 sponsored by XOMA

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: XOMA Royalty Corp transitioned to a biotech royalty aggregator. It does not develop drugs internally; instead, it acquires economic rights (milestone and royalty payments) on partnered pre-commercial clinical candidates being developed by third parties. It sponsors no active P1/P2/P3 trials of its own.
excluded_legacy_terminated: Gevokizumab (anti-IL-1beta) — multiple Phase 2/3 trials in pyoderma gangrenosum, Behcet's uveitis, non-infectious uveitis, osteoarthritis, acne, autoimmune inner ear disease — all TERMINATED or COMPLETED
XOMA 052 (gevokizumab) — Phase 1/2 trials in type 1 and type 2 diabetes mellitus, rheumatoid arthritis — COMPLETED or SUSPENDED
XOMA 358 (X358) — Phase 2 trials in hypoglycemia post-gastric-bypass and congenital hyperinsulinism — COMPLETED
Opebacan — Phase 1/2 in graft-versus-host disease — TERMINATED
HCD122 — Novartis-led Phase 1 / Phase 1-2 in CLL and lymphoma — TERMINATED/COMPLETED
